parts:
Hello,

I would like to ask 2 questions from Cameletti et al paper:
1) what is the difference in setting an observation structure for validation data versus not setting one?
2) if no difference, then in the mesh construction should all coordinates contribute or only those from the estimation data?

In the code of that paper the A.est, A.val, A.pred are defined (inla.spde.make.A).
The first question could translate in whether it matters if for some values of the response there was just an NA and the mesh, spde objects were used?
eg:
mesh <- ...#with coordinates from both estimation and validation data? #second question
spde <- ...#as in the code
Piemonte_data <- rbind(Piemonte_data,Piemonte_data_validation) #given that this applies and with Piemonte_data_validation$logPM10 <- rep(NA, nrow(Piemonte_data_validation))
result <- inla(formula,data=Piemonte_data,......)

Thanks,
Alex
